title: SSH Config Generator
description: Build ~/.ssh/config Host entries — alias, hostname, user, port, identity file — with sane defaults.

faqs.a: alias|hostname|user|port|identityfile — port and identity file are optional; empty fields fall back to SSH defaults.

faqs.q: What do the global options do?
faqs.a: ServerAliveInterval/ServerAliveCountMax keep idle connections from timing out.
No — everything is generated locally in your browser.
